why: decode is what you watch; prefill is what an agent loop pays per turn

decode.prompt: Write a detailed 400-word technical explanation of how a write-ahead log keeps a database durable across a crash. Plain prose, no bullet points, no headings.

prefill.nonce_why: identical long prompts hit Ollama's prefix cache; repeats 2..K then report cache-hit fiction (observed 19444 tok/s on a device that does ~140). The nonce MUST vary per repeat.
